title: Lesson 12
description: Vocabulary from Lesson 12 — the future tense, including the deponent futures of γίνομαι, γινώσκω, ἔρχομαι, and λαμβάνω.

cards.back: I will become (deponent fut. of γίνομαι)
I will know (deponent fut. of γινώσκω)
if, whether (usually followed by an indicative mood verb)
I will come (deponent fut. of ἔρχομαι)
I will take, receive (deponent fut. of λαμβάνω)
